import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    int n, m, k, t;
    List<List<Edge>> adj;
    int[] u, v, prio, curflow, prevedge, prevnode, potential;

    static class Edge {
        int to, flow, capacity, cost, rev;
        Edge(int to, int flow, int capacity, int cost, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    public MinCostFlow(int n) {
        this.n = n;
        u = new int[n];
        v = new int[n];
        prio = new int[n];
        curflow = new int[n];
        prevedge = new int[n];
        prevnode = new int[n];
        potential = new int[n];
        adj = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
    }

    public void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cst) {
        adj.get(s).add(new Edge(t, 0, cap, cst, adj.get(t).size()));
        adj.get(t).add(new Edge(s, 0, 0, -cst, adj.get(s).size() - 1));
    }

    public int[] minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(prio, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            PriorityQueue<int[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new int[]{0, s});
            prio[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(curflow, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                int[] top = pq.poll();
                int d = top[0], u = top[1];
                if (d != prio[u]) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                    int v = e.to;
                    if (e.flow >= e.capacity) continue;
                    int newDist = prio[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[v];
                    if (prio[v] > newDist) {
                        prio[v] = newDist;
                        pq.offer(new int[]{newDist, v});
                        prevnode[v] = u;
                        prevedge[v] = i;
                        curflow[v] = Math.min(curflow[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (prio[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                potential[i] += prio[i];
            }
            int df = Math.min(curflow[t], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                Edge e = adj.get(prevnode[v]).get(prevedge[v]);
                e.flow += df;
                adj.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= df;
                totalCost += df * e.cost;
            }
            totalFlow += df;
        }
        return new int[]{totalFlow, totalCost};
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        MinCostFlow flowNetwork = new MinCostFlow(6 + 107 * n);

        for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            x--;
            flowNetwork.addEdge(0, 1 + x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= 50; j++) {
                    flowNetwork.addEdge(1 + i * n + x, 1 + (i + 1) * n + y, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    flowNetwork.addEdge(1 + i * n + y, 1 + (i + 1) * n + x, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                flowNetwork.addEdge(1 + i * n + j, 1 + (i + 1) * n + j, 51, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 104; i++) {
            flowNetwork.addEdge(1 + i * n, 1 + 105 * n, 51, 0);
        }

        int[] result = flowNetwork.minCostMaxFlow(0, 1 + 105 * n);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
